string.value: A new license key is required for #product.fullproductnamenospace#update.
I have read the documentation and understood the process to request the new license key. I agree to add the new license key after update installation.
For SAP Crystal Reports purchased as part of SAP Business Intelligence Platform, you can go to the link below and learn how to request the new license key.
For SAP Crystal Reports purchased separately, you should visit sap store and purchase an upgrade license key.
You have to enter the new license key in the License Manager when you launch the application after the update installation.
